data.revised_prompt: High-quality 3D chibi educational app avatar icon, centered single fictional Chinese schoolgirl ages 8-14, clearly a student. Square 1:1 composition, tightly focused on head and face, front view or slight 2/3 view, full hair outline visible, face and hair occupying 75%-85% of the canvas, only a tiny hint of shoulders/neck and a small white school collar visible at the bottom; absolutely not a half-body portrait. Straight long hair with a natural middle part, smooth and neatly modeled, wearing a thin sky-blue headband. Bright friendly open-mouth smile showing teeth. Bright brown eyes, soft studio lighting, soft materials, delicate modeling, high contrast, readable at 48px, bold silhouette, minimal detail. The entire square canvas must be fully filled edge-to-edge with a solid low-saturation lilac purple background, extending from left to right and top to bottom and into all corners, with no white border, no transparency, no circular frame, no halo, and no scene elements. Clothing: only a tiny visible white campus-style turn-down collar, no emblem, no text. Clean centered icon asset for a school teacher-side student avatar library. Avoid adult features, teacher look, headphones, headset, earrings, makeup, hands, props, western suit, dark tones, low resolution, cropped hair, cropped chin, off-center placement, large shoulders, multi-character, realistic photo, flat 2D illustration, watermark, logo, letters, numbers.
